subject: english
stem: A notice says visitors may sit in every open chair. Which rewrite uses any?
options: Visitors may use any open chair.
Visitors may not use any open chair.
Visitors use some chair are open.

optionRationales.reason: Visitors may use much chairs.：much 不搭複數。
Visitors may use any open chair.：any 表任一開放座位都可。
Visitors may not use any open chair.：改成禁止。
Visitors use some chair are open.：數與結構錯誤。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「依肯定、否定、一般問句及期待肯定的提議／請求語意，選 some 或 any，並維持名詞可數性。」可推出 Visitors may use any open chair.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Visitors may use any open chair. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
